name: Piece of Krom'zar's Banner
summary: At Regthar Deathgate's bunker west of the Crossroads, a torn banner marks the broken assault. Warlord Krom'zar led the Kolkar retaliatory force from Desolace.

sections.title: Trophy of the Centaur Incursion
sections.body: Warlord Krom'zar led a warband east from Desolace to strike back. Kolkar chieftains across the Barrens had fallen, and the furious centaurs attacked the defensive bunkers west of the Crossroads. A strip cut from Krom'zar's fallen standard gives Regthar Deathgate proof that the assault was crushed and the southern trade routes were preserved for the Horde.

faq.q: What is this banner piece used for?
aliases: what do i do with banner piece
faq.answer: Bring the torn cloth to Regthar Deathgate at his bunker west of the Crossroads. It proves Warlord Krom'zar was slain and his raiding force shattered, ending the defense of the northern Barrens.
Krom'zar was a Kolkar commander from Desolace. He led a direct counterattack against Horde outposts after local Kolkar leaders were killed.

faq.q: Why did the Kolkar attack the bunker?
faq.answer: After Barak, Verog, and Hezrul and the other local chieftains fell, the enraged centaur gathered reinforcements from Desolace to take vengeance on the Horde presence west of the Crossroads.

faq.q: Does Thrall hear of this victory?
faq.answer: Yes. Regthar Deathgate promises to send word directly to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar, praising the defenders who broke the invasion.

angles.text: Defeating Krom'zar and taking his banner stops a major centaur offensive. The northern routes between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Crossroads are secure.
As a tauren, you know centaur aggression has long troubled the nomadic tribes. Krom'zar's vanguard is destroyed, and the trails toward Mulgore are safer.
